privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.analytics_facts: Vercel Web Analytics loads only after acceptance in the preference banner. Unknown and rejected choices prevent loading. Changing the choice in the footer blocks future events through the SDK event filter; it does not recall requests already sent.
privacy.preference_facts: The browser stores the analytics choice under cojauny-studio-consent in localStorage. Language routing may set a NEXT_LOCALE preference cookie. You can review the analytics choice using the preferences control in the footer.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies and similar technologies.

content.heading: Your browser preferences
content.choice_body: Cojauny Studio shows a preference banner. Unknown or rejected choices do not load the analytics script. Accepting loads Vercel Web Analytics. You can review or withdraw that choice using Analytics preferences in the footer; future events are then blocked. Requests already sent cannot be recalled.
content.storage_body: The cojauny-studio-consent localStorage entry records accepted or rejected in this browser. If storage is unavailable, the choice applies only to the current tab. Language routing can also set the NEXT_LOCALE preference cookie.
content.services_body: The contact form uses our server and Resend to deliver enquiries. A deployment with Cloudflare Turnstile configured can also load its anti-abuse widget. These contact services are separate from optional analytics.

about.title: About Cojauny Studio
about.description: We are a product-focused software studio building digital products for the European market.
about.hero_subheadline: We are a lean, product-obsessed software studio. We build high-quality digital products and help European businesses launch theirs.
about.mission_body: We believe every line of code should serve a purpose. We do not add features for the sake of it, we do not over-engineer, and we do not ship anything we would not use ourselves. The result: lean, reliable software that solves real problems.
about.value_craft_desc: We care about the quality of every decision — architecture, UX, and copy alike.
about.value_honesty_desc: We tell clients what we think, not what they want to hear. Good advice requires it.
about.value_focus_desc: We work on a small number of things at once so we can do each one properly.
about.value_ownership_desc: We take responsibility for outcomes, not just deliverables.
about.ecosystem_body: We build our own products alongside client work. This keeps us sharp: every tool, pattern, and practice we recommend is one we actually use.
about.product_cojauny_desc: A flight-sharing coordination platform connecting travelers on the same flight for shared transport to and from airports.
about.product_cuatrosotas_desc: Online multiplayer card game based on the traditional Spanish Guiñote. Features AI, Bluetooth multiplayer, and global rankings.
about.approach_body: We keep process lightweight and output high. No bloated sprints, no management theatre. We communicate clearly, ship regularly, and adapt when needed.
about.approach_item_1_desc: We understand your problem before proposing a solution.
about.approach_item_2_desc: Working software shipped in regular, reviewable increments.
about.approach_item_3_desc: You always know what we are working on and why.
about.cta_body: Whether you have a project in mind or just want to talk about technology, we are happy to start a conversation.
